newsitem.title: USA: Mayors' group taps Bridgeport Mayor for muni panel.
newsitem.headline: Mayors' group taps Bridgeport Mayor for muni panel.

text.p: Bridgeport Mayor Joseph Ganim Monday announced that he has been named chairman of the municipal bonds subcommittee of the United States Conference of Mayors (USCM).
Chicago Mayor Richard Daley, USCM's president, told Ganim of his appointment in a letter written on the conference's behalf, a release from Bridgeport City Hall said.

"As president of the United States Conference of Mayors this year, I am pleased to appoint you as chair of the municipal bonds subcommittee of the standing committee on urban economic policy," Daley wrote.

Ganim, who became mayor after his predecessor attempted to file for bankruptcy on Bridgeport's behalf, was able to pass along a small tax cut this year, the release said. Ganim said his experiences with Bridgeport's finances will help him chair the subcommittee.

"There is no doubt that all that I have learned in helping to manage and plan Bridgeport's finances will lend some great perspective to my position on this committee. I look forward to sharing with other mayors and municipal officials my views on financial planning, and I know that I will benefit from hearing other people's opinions on what they have done in their cities," Ganim said.
